ideas.pitch: A custom-built 350x350mm wireless rover utilizing dual high-torque DC motors and a 6S LiPo power delivery system optimized for scaling steep slopes and heavy-duty obstacle navigation.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Race: navigate an obstacle-based track featuring slopes, ramps, bridges, rollers, seesaws, tunnels, and sharp turns in the shortest possible time using a custom-built, manually controlled wireless robot.
ideas.title: TorqueMaster 6S: High-Torque Wireless Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on strict compliance with the 5kg weight and 24V/6S voltage constraints while maximizing raw power-to-weight ratio to conquer steep ramps and seesaws faster than competitors.

ideas.pitch: A low-center-of-gravity wireless tracked vehicle designed specifically to maintain maximum stability across shifting rollers and bridges without shedding any mandatory retention components.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Race: navigate an obstacle-based track featuring challenges such as slopes, ramps, bridges, rollers, seesaws, tunnels, and sharp turns under strict component retention rules.
ideas.title: Low-CG Roller-Runner Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the strict disqualification rule for dropped parts by utilizing lock-nut hardware and reinforced chassis mounting to guarantee component retention across violent mechanical rollers and bumps.

ideas.pitch: A nimble, compact 4-wheel drive robot featuring independent skid-steering and real-time throttle curve adjustment to master extremely tight hairpin turns and narrow tunnel clearances.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Race: navigate an obstacle-based track featuring challenges such as slopes, ramps, bridges, rollers, seesaws, tunnels, and sharp turns in the shortest possible time.
ideas.title: AgileTurn: Differential Steering Precision Racer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimized specifically for the dimensions constraint (maximum 350x350 mm) to maximize agility and maneuverability through blind sharp turns revealed on race day.

ideas.pitch: A manually controlled rover equipped with a forward-weighted weight-shifting balance plate designed to instantly stabilize the robot on pivoting seesaws and ramps.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Race: navigate an obstacle-based track featuring challenges such as slopes, ramps, bridges, rollers, seesaws, tunnels, and sharp turns.
ideas.title: Seesaw-Balance Shift Chassis
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the notorious seesaw tipping hazard by integrating a mechanical balancing slope adjustment that prevents stalls during weight transitions.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-low profile wireless robot engineered to stay well under size limits while carrying high-capacity 6S LiPo power safely through low-hanging tunnels and obstacle zones.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Robo Race: navigate an obstacle-based track featuring challenges such as slopes, ramps, bridges, rollers, seesaws, tunnels, and sharp turns.
ideas.title: TunnelProof Compact Scout
ideas.why_it_could_win: Prioritizes minimal vertical height and robust physical shielding to survive impacts inside enclosed tunnels while keeping well within the 350x350 mm footprint.
